parsed.explanation: Rated on traveller-facing exposure. Entry screening: the February 2025 cable directs refusal of applicants with sex-document discrepancies, and a lifetime fraud ground is available, though no imposition is documented. Facilities: bans cover roughly 22 states plus one unit, with 6 reaching private settings and 4 making use criminal in some circumstances. One documented arrest, with 24 hours held in a men's ward, is the only traveller-relevant custody case. National state-threat framing (counterterrorism language, 'radically pro-transgender') and allied travel advisories add pressure. Mitigators: no sodomy law, national employment and hate-crime coverage, and anti-discrimination law in 22 states plus DC, though enforcement of these is not documented. No trans-specific violence rate is available, so that axis is undocumented. Many states have no ban, and the dossier documents the arrest as the first of its kind.
